subject: Split-sprint red team engagement & remediation windows — scope questions
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@redshield-security.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Split-sprint red team engagement & remediation windows — scope questions

Ben —

Thanks again for the proposal. We're interested in the idea of splitting the red team across two focused sprints (thin-slice sprint A: auth/SSO & infra; sprint B: core model infra and API surfaces) to limit blast radius and let our teams remediate between waves. A few quick questions before we loop procurement: 

- Pricing: can you break the SOW into per-sprint line items (hours + flat travel/coordination fee) so we can budget incremental spend?
- Evidence handling: we need an evidence playbook that states how artifacts are transferred, retention timeline (90 days preferred), and redaction process for customer data. Can you confirm you support encrypted artifact bundles delivered to our Drive + hashed manifest?
- Timing: typical turnaround between sprint close and final report we should expect (we'd like draft findings within 5 business days per sprint).
- Scope edge cases: will social engineering be scoped separately? If so, estimate separate pricing.

If you can send an annotated SOW (per-sprint pricing + evidence clause) by EOD Friday that'd help us move to PO. CC'ing Lauren and Hannah — Lauren, Hannah: any procurement/eng ops asks I should include before I push this to vendor?

Appreciate it —
Alex Martinez
Security Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@redshield-security.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Split-sprint red team engagement & remediation windows — scope questions

Alex —

Thanks for the clear direction. Attached is a draft SOW that splits the engagement into two distinct sprint engagements (RedShield_SOW_split-sprint_v1.pdf). High-level answers inline: 

- Pricing: SOW has line items per sprint (base engagement hours, senior lead days, optional social engineering add-on). We included a discounted combined rate if both sprints are booked together.
- Evidence handling: we can provide an encrypted artifact bundle delivered to your shared Drive folder; bundle includes a SHA256 manifest and we retain raw evidence for 90 days by default. We can extend to 180 days on request (additional fee).
- Turnaround: draft findings within 3-5 business days after final day of testing for each sprint, final report + remediation guidance within 10 business days.
- Social engineering: scoped as an optional addendum. We propose a separate 2-week window; pricing shown in Appendix B.

Operational notes: we require two-week access windows for on-prem components (jumpbox + short-lived service account) and ability to upload artifacts to a pre-provisioned Drive folder. I attached a short vendor-access-checklist.xlsx to capture required accounts and scoping questions.

Next steps: if that SOW structure looks good, we can prepare a DocuSign packet and a PO-ready quote. We accept standard SOW + redlines; our standard T&Cs are included at the end of the PDF.

Thanks,
Ben Turner
Engagement Lead — RedShield Security
Attachments: RedShield_SOW_split-sprint_v1.pdf, vendor-access-checklist.xlsx
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Split-sprint red team engagement & remediation windows — scope questions

Ben —

Appreciate the fast turnaround, the split pricing and the evidence approach look promising. Two internal items before we move to DocuSign: 

1) Retention: can you make the 90-day retention the default in the SOW but include a 90->180 escalation clause with a fixed fee? We need that explicitly called out for our compliance team.

2) Data handling: please add explicit language around PII redaction and an acceptance process for redactions (we need a hashed manifest + an on-call contact for post-release clarifications).

Internal ask to Lauren/Hannah: can you confirm procurement's preferred PO flow (template + lead time) and whether we should do a single PO for the combined engagement or two separate POs per sprint? If we get a combined PO we can apply the bundled discount Ben included.

Ben, once we have the revised SOW with those two clauses I will loop in our procurement contact (cc'ed below) and request a PO.

Alex / Ben —

Quick operational confirm from procurement side: Acme Procurement (cc) is our preferred PO handler for third-party SOWs under $150k. For this engagement, procurement prefers a single PO if the vendor offers a bundled discount (so please include both sprint line items on one quote). Our typical timeline from signed SOW to issued PO is 5-7 business days provided the SOW is final and the vendor's W-9 and insurance certificates are attached. 

Action items: 
- Ben: please include the 90->180 retention fee as an optional line in the SOW and add PII redaction acceptance language. Also attach your W-9 and insurance certs to the DocuSign packet.
- Alex: after Ben updates the SOW we'll circulate final SOW + quote to Acme Procurement and request PO.

Ben — if you attach the updated PDF to the DocuSign packet and confirm acceptance of a single-PO flow we'll start the PO process immediately.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Ops (Finance liaison)
Redwood Inference
